headline_hint: SAD leader Sukhbir Singh Badal injured in kirpan attack outside Nanded gurdwara

raw_model_output.headline: Akali Dal Leader Sukhbir Singh Badal Wounded in Attack Outside Nanded Gurdwara
raw_model_output.body:
Shiromani Akali Dal chief Sukhbir Singh Badal suffered injuries to his arm and shoulder in a kirpan attack outside Gurdwara Mata Sahib in Nanded [c72]. Police identified the suspect who attacked Sukhbir Singh Badal as 62-year-old Jaspal Singh Teja Singh Aidal, a law graduate from Pune [c71].

This incident follows previous violent attempts targeting the political figure. Sukhbir Singh Badal previously survived an assassination attempt at the Golden Temple in Amritsar on December 4, 2024 [c73].
